# Void Studio

> Void Studio (Void Studio . Lab) is an independent studio that builds websites, web tools, mobile apps, bots, automation, and AI images and video. The site is a portfolio with contacts. Russian is the main language, English lives under /en/.

## Pages

- [Home](https://voidstudio.top/): a strip of selected visual work
- [Studio](https://voidstudio.top/studio.html): approach, services, selected projects, contacts
- [Projects](https://voidstudio.top/projects.html): the full list of projects with links
- [Home, English](https://voidstudio.top/en/)
- [Studio, English](https://voidstudio.top/en/studio.html)
- [Projects, English](https://voidstudio.top/en/projects.html)

## Projects

- [Surf](https://voidstudio.top/en/projects/surf.html): surf forecast for Phuket, waves, wind, tide and live cams scored by beach. Live at https://surf.voidstudio.top
- [Inkfall](https://voidstudio.top/en/projects/inkfall.html): ink in water, a GPU fluid simulation driven by mouse, touch, hand gestures or voice. Live at https://inkfall.voidstudio.top
- [Eyeball / Глазомер](https://voidstudio.top/en/projects/glazomer.html): a daily browser game, five tasks done by eye. Live at https://glazomer.voidstudio.top
- [Argyns](https://voidstudio.top/en/projects/argyns.html): an iOS and Android app, a digital registry for the twelve Argyn clans
- [FitTimer](https://voidstudio.top/en/projects/fittimer.html): an interval training timer for iPhone and iPad
- [Poster 2.0](https://voidstudio.top/en/projects/poster.html): a system that prepares and schedules one release for Telegram, Instagram, YouTube and Pikabu
- [Podcast Bot](https://voidstudio.top/en/projects/podcast.html): a Telegram bot that collects podcasts from RSS, YouTube and Telegram into one channel

Russian versions of the project pages live under /projects/.

## Services

- [Websites and interactive work](https://voidstudio.top/en/websites.html): landing pages, portfolios, web services, browser games, WebGL graphics
- [Apps and prototypes](https://voidstudio.top/en/apps.html): iOS and Android apps with Flutter, working product prototypes
- [Bots and automation](https://voidstudio.top/en/automation.html): Telegram bots, scheduled publishing, audio and video processing
- [AI images and video](https://voidstudio.top/en/ai-visuals.html): advertising shots, posters, illustration, short videos

Russian versions of the service pages: /websites.html, /apps.html, /automation.html, /ai-visuals.html

## Blog

- [Scheduled social posting](https://voidstudio.top/en/blog/scheduled-social-posting.html): publishing to several platforms on a schedule, explained through Poster 2.0
- [A Telegram bot for business](https://voidstudio.top/en/blog/telegram-bot-for-business.html): what a Telegram bot can do and what its cost depends on
- [An app MVP](https://voidstudio.top/en/blog/app-mvp.html): what an app MVP is and how to build the first version
- [Interactive websites](https://voidstudio.top/en/blog/interactive-website.html): what an interactive website is, with examples

Russian versions of the articles live under /blog/.
